sourceText: Split docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-heartbeat-review-assurance-ux-execution-plan.md into three Proofbound stories and implement them sequentially to DONE. Story A covers M0-M2: done_prepare closure progress heartbeat, JSON-safe liveness, and independent closeout phase deadlines.
normalizedOutcome: B-eb08 makes lattice done_prepare visibly report post-validation closeout progress while preserving JSON stdout and fail-closed lifecycle semantics.
acceptanceClaim: A TEST-story done_prepare run emits diagnostic progress for evaluating DONE closure, checking review assurance, computing runtime-change status, checking clean tree, and producing the DONE command; --json stdout remains parseable; and a deliberately hung closeout phase blocks with an attributed phase-timeout.
